title: Nourishing Crispy Russian Beef Dumplings
description: A romantic Russian dish featuring fermented dough and crispy beef dumplings, flavored with allspice and cooked to perfection in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, this halal-friendly recipe is sure to delight. It is a hearty and nourishing meal option.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, allspice, onion, and garlic, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, water, yeast, and salt, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth and let it ferment in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle and fold the dough over to form a dumpling.
Heat the vegetable oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 5 minutes on each side until they are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
Let the dumplings rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
